Synthetic codec fixtures generated from known pixels, containing no book content.

- `six-colours.jp2`: lossless 2×3 RGB JPEG 2000, rows red/green, blue/yellow, magenta/cyan.
- `checkerboard-group3.bin` and `checkerboard-group4.bin`: raw CCITT strips from a 9×3 one-bit checkerboard encoded using Pillow/libtiff. The first logical pixel is white; TIFF PhotometricInterpretation is 1 (BlackIsZero).
